meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给你的聊天服务添加 Matrix 渠道:把官方分支里的 Matrix 适配器复制进代码、登记进渠道列表、装固定版本的依赖包、修正一处导入路径错误,再运行构建和测试来确认可用。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 Matrix 渠道”“接入 Matrix”,或提出配置 Matrix 机器人账号时,这个技能会开始执行。

say.text: 帮我添加 Matrix 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器并完成注册、构建。

say.text: 用密码方式配置 Matrix 机器人
say.note: 会引导你输入用户名和密码写入配置。

say.text: 把 Matrix 自动加入的允许列表设成只收我的邀请

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds Matrix support to the chat service: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, patches a Node import issue, then runs build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'add a Matrix channel', 'integrate Matrix', or ask to configure a Matrix bot account.

say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then builds.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with username and password.
say_en.note: Prompts for credentials and writes them to env.

say_en.text: Set the auto-join allowlist to only my user ID.
say_en.note: Makes the bot ignore invites from others.
